entries.zh: 曾经连绵不绝的毒山，一度占据了整个星球，现在只剩最后一小片毒物的残留。
entries.en: The last toxic remains of the once enormous mountains of poison that dominated this world.

entries.zh: 在我们对这个星球执行第一轮清理后，这些有毒海藻仍然幸存了下来。尽管它对于殖民活动的侵害还不足以造成阻碍，但还是具有相当强的适应能力……有时候会变得很恼人。
entries.en: This noxious algae survived the initial cleansing of this world. While it is not aggressive enough to prevent colonization, it has proven highly adaptable... and quite simply a nuisance.

entries.zh: 恶毒害虫的最后一窝，我们本希望在环境改造工作前期就把它们一股脑消灭掉。
entries.en: The lost broods of venomous vermin that we had hoped to extinguish during the early days of our terraforming effort.

entries.zh: 空气中恶心的气味和味道，是这个行星剧毒过往的残留印记。
entries.en: The disgusting taste and smell of the air are what remains of this planet's toxic past.

entries.zh: 对其进行清洗和翻新之后，即使是这样的腐泥也能对我们大有裨益。
entries.en: Even this rotten soil will be useful to us, once it has been refreshed and reinvigorated.
Spliced Adaptability

entries.zh: §L对基因片段的各处进行裁切和移接使他们可以在几乎任何环境下生存。这个过程的副作用会造成一定数量的死亡，但过程总体可控。§!
entries.en: §LA few genetic snips and slices here and there and they can survive nearly anywhere. The process comes with an acceptable number of deaths from side effects.§!
Habitability: §G+20%§!
Juiced Power

entries.zh: §L根据需要释放的肾上腺素和超强力生长激素使其变得无比强健。只需要无视体内偶尔发出撕裂的声音即可。§!
entries.en: §LAdrenaline released on demand and hyper-potent growth hormones have led to a massive increase in strength. Just ignore the occasional internal tearing.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ Workers: §G+5%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $soldier_jobs_bonus_workforce_mult$: §G+15%§!
Dedicated Miner

entries.zh: §L超强的手眼协调，几乎无限的耐力和自净化的肺部催生出了完美的采矿团队。只可惜他们因远离阳光而变得易于骨折。§!
entries.en: §LSupreme hand-eye coordination, near endless endurance and self-purifying lungs have created entire crack teams of miners. Sadly they get brittle without sunlight.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_miners']: §G+15%§!
Farm Appendages

entries.zh: §L附肢越多，种地就越强。其中一些附肢甚至可以在主体进入睡眠后继续工作。至于主体被自己新的附肢勒死一事，我们最新的调查显示纯属谣言。§!
entries.en: §LThe more appendages, the higher the farming output. Some appendages can even operate while their host is asleep. Rumors of hosts strangled by their new limbs have been deemed unfounded in our latest investigation.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_farmers']: §G+15%§!
Technical Talent

entries.zh: §L额外的内部器官可以大大提高对电和磁场的先天敏感性。受改造者在反应堆里听到尖叫和低语的报告应该被忽略。§!
entries.en: §LExtra internal organs grant a vastly increased innate sensitivity to electricity and magnetic fields. Reports of recipients hearing screams and voices from the reactors should be ignored.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_technician']: §G+15%§!
Commercial Genius

entries.zh: §L通过有意识地调整适应能力并适当降低同理心，可以激发出卓越的交易天赋。在追求卓越的商业主导地位时，这一目标的重要性远远超越了可能产生的任何副作用。§!
entries.en: §LBy tweaking agreeability and dialing down empathy, it is possible to artificially kindle a spark of trading genius. The pursuit of unmatched commercial dominance outweighs any potential side effects.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_traders']: §G+25%§!
Crafted Smiles

entries.zh: §L面部特征的轻微调整、肌肉发育增强和松弛相互结合，再加上一些外在化学物质，创造了永恒完美的微笑。§!
entries.en: §LSlightly shifted facial features, a mix of enhanced and slackened muscular development - and of course outside chemicals - have created the perfect smile. Forever.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_influential']: §G+15%§!
Low Maintenance

entries.zh: §L降低消耗、排泄和休息率使其事半功倍。然而对高蛋白食物的需求提升了。§!
entries.en: §LReduced consumption, excretion, and rest rates have resulted in twice the beings for half the price. However, demand for protein-rich meals has increased.§!
Pop Consumer Goods Upkeep: §G-10%§!
Augmented Intelligence

entries.zh: §L脑子越多智力越高。在受改造者体内的关键位置增加额外的思考器官可以最大化他们的认知能力。尽管各个脑子间并不总能达成一致。§!
entries.en: §LMore brains equals more brain power. Extra thinking organs have been added in strategic areas of the recipient's body to ensure maximum cognitive capacity. Even if they don't always agree.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_researchers']: §G+10%§!
Gene Mentorship

entries.zh: §L通过基因层面重构的“本能知识”和外部化学刺激的组合，我们得以大大加速学习过程。尽管这会导致极为罕见的妄想症个案出现。§!
entries.en: §LBy combining genetically redesigned 'instinctive knowledge' and outside chemical stimuli, we have succeeded in vastly accelerating our learning capacities. Although it has resulted in some extremely paranoid individuals.§!
Leader Experience Gain: §G+30%§!
Expressed Tradition

entries.zh: §L按需狂热：信念只不过是激素的调和，我们已对其了如指掌。至于信念最终将走向何处取决于后续如何引导。§!
entries.en: §LFanaticism on demand: faith is merely a cocktail of hormones, one we have perfected. Where that faith eventually leads is a matter of subsequent guidance.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_bureaucrats']: §G+10%§!
Elevated Synapses

entries.zh: §L大脑作为计算设备其实并非在100%功率下运转。然而我们已经大大超出了平均水平。如果遇到问题请重新启动。§!
entries.en: §LAs a computational device, a brain does not run at 100% capacity. However, we have gone beyond the standard usage. If issues are encountered, try turning it off and on again.§!
$BONUS_WORKFORCE_FOR$ ['concept_planet_researchers']: §G+20%§!
Pre-Planned Growth

entries.zh: §L计划繁育、计划吸引、计划婚配。按需增长可以塑造强大而稳定的人口——只要前前后后进行一些简单的基因编辑即可得偿所愿。产生嫉妒的个体会被引导前往最近的生育中心，进行强制训练。§!
entries.en: §LScheduled fertility, scheduled interest, scheduled compatibility. Population growth on demand for a strong and stable population - with a few minor edits here and there. Jealous individuals are to be directed to the nearest Fertility Center for mandatory training.§!

entries.zh: 人口增长速度：§G+30%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$—人口住房使用：§G-10%§!
entries.en: Pop Growth Speed: §G+30%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- Pop Housing Usage: §G-10%§!
Excessive Endurance

entries.zh: §L在这些个体上，最强的适应性基因被过度表达了。我们达成了约30%的变异率，足以宣告实验稳定且成功。§!
entries.en: §LThe greatest in adaptability genes have been hyper-expressed in these specimens. Mutation rates around 30% indicate a somewhat stable and successful experiment.§!
Habitability: §G+30%§!$TABBED_NEW_LINE$- $MOD_POP_BONUS_WORKFORCE_MULT$: §G+5%§!
Damn the Consequences

entries.zh: 该法令将我们的基因修饰推向极致，使其效果翻倍，但同时也使出现恶性副作用的概率有所上升，包括突发灾难性的爆燃。\n\n§R无惧后果将无视['concept_edict_fund']，并始终消耗你每月$unity_with_icon$收入的80%！§!
entries.en: This Edict pushes our genetic modifications to the very limit, doubling their effect but also causing an increased amount of terrible side-effects, including sudden catastrophic combustion.\n\n§RDamn the Consequences ignores ['concept_edict_fund'] and will always use 80% of your monthly $unity_with_icon$ income!§!

entries.zh: 所有§H强夺天工§!特质的正面效果翻倍。
entries.en: All positive effects from §HOvertuned§! Traits are doubled.
Exotic Mountains

entries.zh: 在这些崇山峻岭的深处隐藏着大量的异星天然气贮藏，这也是我们生物学的核心。
entries.en: Deep within these mountains lie vast reserves of exotic gases - the core of our biology.
